# Let's check NCBI for PSMD10 and KLHDC3
import requests

def get_ncbi_summary(gene_symbol):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=gene&term={gene_symbol}[Gene+Name]+AND+human[Organism]&retmode=json"
    res = requests.get(url).json()
    id_list = res["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
    print(f"{gene_symbol} Gene IDs:", id_list)
    if id_list:
        summary_url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id={id_list[0]}&retmode=json"
        summary_res = requests.get(summary_url).json()
        print(summary_res["result"][id_list[0]]["description"])

get_ncbi_summary("KLHDC3")
